newsitem.title: USA: ReliaStar Financing II sells trust preferred.
newsitem.headline: ReliaStar Financing II sells trust preferred.

text.p: The following issue of trust originated preferred stock (TOPRS) from ReliaStar Financing II was priced on Thursday, according to lead manager Merrill, Lynch & Co Inc.

The trust will use proceeds from the sale to purchase debt securities to be issued by the parent company ReliaStar Financial Corp, a Minneapolis-based holding company for insurance and other financial services businesses.
TYPE TOPRS ISS PRICE 100.00 FIRST PAY DATE 09/1/1997
LAST MOODY'S A3 DIV YIELD 8.10 PAY FREQ QUARTERLY
